term.definition: A complex rational expression is a rational expression in which the numerator or denominator contains a rational expression.

term.word: extraneous solution to a rational equation
term.definition: An extraneous solution to a rational equation is an algebraic solution that would cause any of the expressions in the original equation to be undefined.
A proportion is an equation of the form $$\frac{a}{b} = \frac{c}{d}$$, where $$b \neq 0,d \neq 0.$$ The proportion is read “$$a$$ is to $$b$$, as $$c$$ is to $$d\text{.}$$”
A rational equation is two rational expressions connected by an equal sign.
A rational expression is an expression of the form $$\frac{p}{q}$$, where p and q are polynomials and $$q \neq 0.$$
Two figures are similar if the measures of their corresponding angles are equal and their corresponding sides are in the same ratio.
